summary: USBC, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that Goldeneye 1995 LLC, holder of ~92.2% voting power, approved by written consent a reverse stock split at a ratio from 1-for-2 to 1-for-5. The Board recommended and approved the split on June 12, 2026. No fractional shares will be issued, and authorized shares are unchanged. The exact ratio and timing are at the Company's discretion within 12 months. A preliminary Schedule 14C was filed on June 22, 2026. The split requires satisfaction of Rule 14c-2 before effectiveness. This is a routine capital structure adjustment, not a special situation.
